_what: The Japan profile layer (plan 10, commitment C-7): data switched on by the site's country (JP, from site.tz). Card 10C-4 (D-1227) adds its committees part; 10C-25 gathers the other parts here. Each rule and source is the project's reading of the public text named, to be confirmed by the first site's trial office; what is recorded here is not the complete set of a site's requirements (see 'elsewhere').

chiken.source: GCP省令 (平成9年厚生省令第28号) 第27条 (the IRB), 第32条 (its review): the IRB's opinion before the trial. Article numbers as read 2026-11-18, not re-verified
chiken.elsewhere: Also needed, not recorded here (the site's own): the trial contract (GCP省令 第13条). To be confirmed by the site's trial office
chiken.permission_is: 実施医療機関の長の指示・決定 (the head of the institution's decision after the IRB), GCP省令 第27条, 統一書式5

tokutei.source: 臨床研究法 (平成29年法律第16号) 第5条 (実施計画 with the CRB's opinion), 第23条 (certified committees). Article numbers as read 2026-11-18, not re-verified
tokutei.elsewhere: Also needed, not recorded here (the site's own): the 実施計画 submitted to the Minister and published in jRCT (臨床研究法 第5条). To be confirmed by the site's trial office
tokutei.permission_is: 実施医療機関の管理者の承認 (the administrator's approval after the CRB), 臨床研究法施行規則

shishin.source: 人を対象とする生命科学・医学系研究に関する倫理指針 第6 (研究計画書に関する手続): the 研究機関の長's permission after the 倫理審査委員会's review; 一括審査 for multicentre research (article numbers as read 2026-11-18, not verified against the 2026 consolidated text)
shishin.elsewhere: Not recorded here: an external ethics committee is not always under a contract (the 指針 asks for the committee's procedures, not a contract); the no_contract warning is the project's reading. To be confirmed by the site's trial office
shishin.permission_is: 研究機関の長の許可 (実施許可, the head of the research institution's permission after the ethics committee), 生命・医学系指針 第6

_ruling: Each kind needs both records to open: the committee's approval and the site's head-of-institution record (permission_is). The lane J lead's ruling of 2026-11-19, following the card, until the owner says otherwise: to change it, edit 'needs' (one line per kind).
